openLink: Or open this link in your browser

signIn.subject: Your Tela sign-in code
signIn.heading: Sign in to Tela
signIn.intro: Enter this code to sign in. It expires in one hour.
signIn.outro: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Tela password
reset.heading: Reset your Tela password
reset.intro: Enter this code to choose a new password. It expires in one hour, and choosing one signs you out everywhere.
reset.outro: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

notice.ifYou: If that was you, there is nothing to do.
notice.othersOut: Every other device was signed out.

providerAccount.subject: Your Tela account was made with {provider}
providerAccount.heading: A new Tela account
providerAccount.what: Someone joined Tela as {to}, signing in with {provider}.
providerAccount.ifNot: If it was not you, the account is still yours: sign in at {login} with a code sent to this address, then remove {provider} and sign out everywhere in Settings → Account.

accountChange.heading: How you sign in to Tela changed
accountChange.newPassword: If it was not you, choose a new password from the sign-in page, {login}: a code comes to this address, and the new password signs everyone else out.

password-set.subject: A password was added to your Tela account
password-set.what: The Tela account for {to} now has a password.

password-changed.subject: Your Tela password was changed
password-changed.what: The password of the Tela account for {to} was changed.

password-reset.subject: Your Tela password was reset
password-reset.what: A new password was chosen for the Tela account for {to}, with a code sent to this address, and every device was signed out.
password-reset.ifNot: If it was not you, someone can read this mailbox: secure it first, then choose a new password again at {login}.

linked.subject: {provider} was linked to your Tela account
linked.what: {provider} now signs in to the Tela account for {to}.
linked.ifNot: If it was not you, sign in at {login} with a code sent to this address, then remove {provider} and sign out everywhere in Settings → Account.

unlinked.subject: {provider} was removed from your Tela account
unlinked.what: {provider} no longer signs in to the Tela account for {to}.
unlinked.ifNot: If it was not you, someone is signed in as you: sign in at {login} with a code sent to this address, then sign out everywhere in Settings → Account, and link {provider} again.
